# Source: Noah Smith

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Noah Smith
- **Artist / culture:** Ralph Earl American, 1751–1801
- **Date:** 1798
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** painting
- **Department:** Arts of the Americas
- **AIC artwork ID:** 2158
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/2158
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/59bf5216-383d-c2d4-912a-f8cfcbdaa55a/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Map Design

## Extracted source palette

`#181808, #382818, #484838, #686848, #583818, #988878, #887858, #B8A898`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#0C0C04`
- `surface`: `#282821`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#583818`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#B8A898`
- `surface_variant`: `#282821`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#4E4E48`
- `error`: `#583818`
- `on_error`: `#F8F8F6`

- Font: `mono` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `18.46:1`, surface `13.95:1`
- Variant contrast: `13.95:1`
- Control contrast: `9.91:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
